cases.name: custom-empty
cases.covers: An empty patch is a present map: it changes nothing and is still well formed.

cases.name: custom-per-key-three-state
cases.covers: A key set, a key removed, and every other key left alone.

cases.name: custom-null
cases.covers: The patch itself is a map: there is no "clear the concept of custom entries", so null is refused.

cases.name: custom-empty-key
cases.covers: An empty key is a key. Whether the engine then rejects it is a different gate.
